Objects and Enhancements in SAP CRM
Objects and Enhancements in SAP CRM
Definition
If you integrate SAP S/4HANA Utilities with SAP CRM, you can use the data cleansing tool in SAP CRM to manage the business partner merge cases and, to some extent, process them in SAP CRM.
Use
For the objects replicated between SAP CRM and SAP S/4HANA Utilities, the change is made to the target business partner in SAP CRM. An exception to this is the contract in SAP CRM. Here, the change to the target business partner is triggered by the
customer change
in SAP S/4HANA Utilities.
For more information about transfer functions for other objects in SAP Utilities, see
Objects and Enhancements in SAP Utilities for Business Partner Merging
.
